text: 1. Application Form (template) 2. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid passport in color. 3. A clearly scanned copy of the high school graduation certificate. 4. A scanned copy of the high school academic transcript for the entire high school period. 5. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (HSK; IELTS, TOEFL, Duolinguo, SAT, GRE and other proofs of English proficiency) 6. Physical Examination Certificate issued within the last 6 months 7. Non-criminal record certificate issued within last 5 months List of other application materials for foreign students in China: 1. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid visa in color 2. Letter of good conduct 3. Study certificate
